description: This file defines the CustomSparkConnectBlockingStub class, which provides a client-side implementation for interacting with Spark Connect server via gRPC. It includes methods for executing plans, analyzing plans, configuring, interrupting, releasing sessions, checking artifact status, and cloning sessions, with retry and exception handling.

classes.name: CustomSparkConnectBlockingStub
classes.description: A client stub for blocking gRPC calls to Spark Connect, supporting plan execution, analysis, configuration, session management, and artifact status with retry and exception handling.

methods.name: executePlan
methods.description: Executes a plan request and returns a closeable iterator over responses, with exception conversion and retries.

methods.name: executePlanReattachable
methods.description: Executes a plan request with a reattachable response iterator that handles retries internally.

methods.name: analyzePlan
methods.description: Analyzes a plan request and returns the analysis response, with exception handling and retries.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration based on the request, with exception handling and retries.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Sends an interrupt request to the server, with exception handling and retries.

methods.name: releaseSession
methods.description: Releases a session, with exception handling and retries.

methods.name: artifactStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of artifacts, with exception handling and retries.

methods.name: cloneSession
methods.description: Clones a session, with exception handling and retries.
